summary.motive: Stretch the defense horizontally from sideline to sideline to create wide running lanes and force linebackers into overpursuit.
summary.whyItWorks: Synchronized lateral steps by all five linemen create multiple double-teams and reach blocks; the running back tracks wide until a natural cutback crease opens.
summary.failureMode: Playside defensive end penetrating the C-gap or backside defensive tackle beating the reach block before the handoff mesh develops.

beats.title: 1. The Lateral Reach Step
beats.text: The entire offensive line fires synchronously on 45-degree lateral reach tracks toward the left sideline. The running back crosses over, aiming for the outside hip of the playside tackle.

beats.title: 2. The Mike Linebacker Flow
beats.text: The defense is forced to move horizontally. Mike linebacker triggers hard playside to protect the C-gap, creating horizontal stretch and opening cutback lanes between the linemen.

beats.title: 3. The Three-Way Read (Bounce / Bang / Bend)
beats.text: The running back presses the tight tackle landmark. Seeing the edge sealed and the Mike flowing wide, the back plants his outside foot and bends sharply into the alley.

beats.title: 4. Second-Level Cutback Burst
beats.text: With backside pursuit sealed off and the Mike overrun, the back bursts through the second level into open field for an explosive gain.

relations.tell: Base run action with full offensive line reach-and-seal flow and RB pressing the playside tackle landmark.
